summary: Three Minnesota snowmobilers became separated and stranded in two locations about 2.5 miles north of Meadow Creek Reservoir; reported ~7:15 p.m. Friday with overnight lows near -20 F; GCSAR snowmobiled 5 miles to staging then snowshoed the final mile; two reached at 2:30 a.m., the third located 6:22 a.m. Saturday after sliding ~600 vertical ft down a steep hillside; all brought down by 10 a.m.; condition not released
location: Meadow Creek Reservoir area (2.5 mi north)
responding_agency: Grand County Search and Rescue (Grand Lake Fire Protection District and Grand Fire Protection District No. 1 support)
notes: Year verified: story says "Friday, February 4" -> 2022-02-04 (a Friday); one GCSAR member suffered first-degree frostbite during the mission 2026-09-20: merged GCSAR FB post permalink (2022-02-04 Meadow Creek Reservoir snowmobilers (three young men from Minnesota, stranded a).
